messages.subject: Re: % of CpG methylated and %CpG methylation in repeat or nonrepeat DNA or in intergenic, intronic, exonic or promoter.
parts:
Possibly you could (1) make a bed file of those regions of interest. Repeats for instance. (2) Read in your bed file with read.feature.flank function which will create a Genomic RangesList feature of repeats.
(3) Use this feature and you target analysis of interest in a call to the function annotate.WithFeature. Finally, (4) call getFeatsWithTargetsStats or getTargetAnnotationStats - depending on what you actually want to know. Load the demo data, review the reference manual to become familiar with how these functions work if you have not done so already.
